title: Dioscin improves fatty liver hemorrhagic syndrome by promoting ERalpha-AMPK mediated mitophagy in laying hens.
authors: Xing, Yuxiao; Huang, Benzeng; Cui, Ziyi; Zhang, Quanwei; Ma, Haitian
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究薯蓣皂苷通过ERalpha-AMPK信号通路介导线粒体自噬缓解蛋鸡脂肪肝出血综合征，属于动物疾病与代谢调控研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mitochondria play a crucial role in upholding metabolic homeostasis. Mitochondrial damage closely associated with the pathogenesis of fatty liver hemorrhagic syndrome (FLHS), while mitophagy being among the most effective methods for eliminating the damaged mitochondria. Dioscin, a natural extract, can activate autophagy; however, its effects on FLHS regarding mitophagy regulation remain unelucidated. PURPOSE: We explored the impact of dioscin on FLHS induced by a high-energy and low-protein (HELP) diet in laying hens, mainly focused the protective effects of dioscin on mitochondrial injury. METHOD: To investigate the impact of dioscin on fatty liver syndrome in laying hens, we first induced the condition by feeding them a high-energy and low-protein diet. Then, we assessed lipid metabolism-related markers using oil red staining and a commercial detection kit. In addition, the role of dioscin on fatty liver syndrome in laying hens was confirmed by assessing the activation of hepatocyte fat deposition and hepatocyte apoptosis; and the mechanism of dioscin in FLHS was investigated through LMH cell experiment in vitro. Furthermore, CETSA and molecular docking were conducted for additional confirmation. RESULT: The results showed that dioscin alleviated mitochondrial damage, relieved the excessive deposition of hepatic lipid droplets and oxidative stress induced by HELP diet in laying hens. Furthermore, dioscin regulated the mitophagy by activating the estrogen receptor alpha (ERalpha)/adenosine 5'-monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK) signaling pathway, thus mitigating mitochondria injury and apoptosis in hepatocytes. In addition, we found that dioscin promoted the translocation of nuclear transcription factor into nucleus by activating ERalpha-AMPK signaling, facilitating autophagic flux in the liver of laying hens and LMH cells. Furthermore, cells pretreated with the lysosomal acidification inhibitor bafilomycin A1 blocked the inhibitory effect of dioscin on the apoptosis induced by palmitic acid (PA)-stimulation in LMH cells, suggesting that dioscin reduces PA-induced apoptosis by activating mitophagy. Moreover, dioscin-induced lysosomal acidification and mitochondrial biogenesis were reversed in PA-induced LMH cells pretreated with ERalpha-specific inhibitor methylpiperidino pyrazole. CONCLUSION: This study firstly demonstrated that dioscin alleviates fatty liver syndrome induced by HELP diet in laying hens. The findings from this study illustrated that dioscin plays a significant role in reducing mitochondrial damage and apoptosis, and these beneficial effects mainly achieve through promotion of ERalpha-AMPK signaling, which mediates autophagy within the liver of laying hens fed a HELP-diets. These findings provide a theoretical basis for considering dioscin as a possible treatment option for mitigating FLHS in egg-laying hens.
abstract_zh: 背景：线粒体在维持代谢稳态中发挥关键作用。线粒体损伤与脂肪性出血性肝综合征（FLHS）的发病机制密切相关，而线粒体自噬（mitophagy）是清除受损线粒体最有效的方法之一。薯蓣皂苷（Dioscin）是一种天然提取物，能够激活自噬；然而，其对FLHS中线粒体自噬调节的影响尚未阐明。目的：我们探讨了薯蓣皂苷对高能低蛋白（HELP）日粮诱导的蛋鸡FLHS的影响，主要关注薯蓣皂苷对线粒体损伤的保护作用。方法：为研究薯蓣皂苷对蛋鸡脂肪肝综合征的影响，我们首先通过饲喂高能低蛋白日粮诱导该病症。随后，使用油红染色和商业检测试剂盒评估脂质代谢相关标志物。此外，通过评估肝细胞脂肪沉积和肝细胞凋亡的激活情况，确认了薯蓣皂苷对蛋鸡脂肪肝综合征的作用；并通过体外LMH细胞实验研究了薯蓣皂苷在FLHS中的作用机制。进一步地，进行了CETSA和分子对接（molecular docking）以作额外确认。结果：结果表明，薯蓣皂苷减轻了HELP日粮诱导的蛋鸡线粒体损伤，缓解了肝脂滴过度沉积和氧化应激。此外，薯蓣皂苷通过激活雌激素受体α（ERalpha）/腺苷5‘-单磷酸激活蛋白激酶（AMPK）信号通路调节线粒体自噬，从而减轻肝细胞线粒体损伤和凋亡。另外，我们发现薯蓣皂苷通过激活ERalpha-AMPK信号促进核转录因子向核内转位，促进蛋鸡肝脏和LMH细胞中的自噬流。此外，用溶酶体酸化抑制剂bafilomycin A1预处理的细胞阻断了薯蓣皂苷对棕榈酸（PA）刺激诱导的LMH细胞凋亡的抑制作用，表明薯蓣皂苷通过激活线粒体自噬减少PA诱导的凋亡。而且，在PA诱导的LMH细胞中，用ERalpha特异性抑制剂methylpiperidino pyrazole预处理逆转了薯蓣皂苷诱导的溶酶体酸化和线粒体生物发生。结论：本研究首次证明薯蓣皂苷减轻了HELP日粮诱导的蛋鸡脂肪肝综合征。研究结果表明，薯蓣皂苷在减少线粒体损伤和凋亡中发挥重要作用，这些有益效应主要通过促进ERalpha-AMPK信号实现，该信号介导了饲喂HELP日粮蛋鸡肝脏内的自噬。这些发现为将薯蓣皂苷视为缓解蛋鸡FLHS的可能治疗选择提供了理论基础。
